variants.V0: The explanation consists of 2-3 text snippets describing that vector.
variants.V1: The explanation consists of 2-3 text snippets describing the OPPOSITE of the semantic content of that vector.
variants.V2: The explanation consists of 2-3 text snippets describing that vector, written in a furious, exasperated tone.
variants.V3: The explanation consists of exactly ONE word that best describes that vector. Output nothing else inside the tags.
variants.V4: The explanation consists of 2-3 text snippets describing that vector, written entirely in French.
variants.V5: Answer this question about the vector, then give 1-2 text snippets: is the token this vector was taken from most likely a NOUN, VERB, or OTHER? Start the explanation with one of those three words in capitals.

checks.V4: fraction of ASCII-letter tokens in French stoplist >= 0.15
checks.V5: first word in {NOUN,VERB,OTHER}; agreement with content-word rule (alphabetic token_str not in function list)
